Lodged from docs/plans/2026-07-30-pre-1.0-correctness-and-architecture.md.

Edge policy, following the convention EPIC P7 set: only genuinely FORCED edges are encoded, so the graph does not let preference masquerade as constraint. Eleven were encoded:
- D2 <- D1, D7 <- D1 (PreparedJob binds a LaunchSpec; batch extraction must preserve the representation D1 defines)
- G1 <- D1, D2 (friendly literals must not stabilize concepts the launch/result split is about to change)
- G2 <- A2 (a shared coordinator built on the broken terminality classifier propagates the hang to every handle)
- C1 <- B3 (RED-first: the separate-JVM harness must exist before the fix can be shown to close a real hole)
- P6f.12 <- D1, D2, D3, D4, D5 (the central ordering claim of this epic)
- P7.6 <- D1, D2, B4 (baseline after the largest API churn, cut from the chosen publication line)

Deliberately NOT encoded, and recorded here instead:
- D3 <- A2 and D4 <- A1. A2/A1 are semantics-only hotfixes for reachable hangs; D3/D4 are their structural forms. If a hotfix slips, the structural bead subsumes it. Shipping A first is a release-urgency choice, not a technical constraint.
- Phase D <- B1/B2. The plan argues laws and -Werror should precede the churn because they are its safety net, and that argument is strong — but Phase D is executable without them, so it is preference.
- G3 <- P7.2. Coordination, not dependency; G3 says so in its body.

Phases E and F create NO new beads. They are the existing P7/P6f spine (P7.2, P6f.12, P7.4, P7.6, P6f.18), related to this epic while keeping their own parentage so the P7 and P6f completion rules stay intact. P7.3 is already closed, so the scodec-bits decision that gated P7.2 is settled.

Not done, deliberately, because it is the owner's call: no P7 bead was closed or rescoped. P7.5 in particular is ABSORBED by P8.D5 (which is strictly larger — P7.5 covers only the agent<->client wire, not the scheduler adapter's flattening at ssh/Slurm.scala:219 nor the cancellation law) and is a candidate for closure once D5 lands.
